name: deekee-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins collection by deekee

plugins.name: explanatory-output-style
plugins.description: Adds educational insights about implementation choices and codebase patterns (mimics the deprecated Explanatory output style)

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive feature development workflow with specialized agents for codebase exploration, architecture design, and quality review

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Easily create custom hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns or from explicit instructions. Define rules via simple markdown files.

plugins.name: learning-output-style
plugins.description: Interactive learning mode that requests meaningful code contributions at decision points (mimics the unshipped Learning output style)

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Comprehensive toolkit for developing Claude Code plugins. Includes 7 expert skills covering hooks, MCP integration, commands, agents, and best practices. AI-assisted plugin creation and validation.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Code quality review agents analyzing local git diff. Specializes in comments, tests, error handling, type design, and code simplification.

plugins.name: ralph-wiggum
plugins.description: Interactive self-referential AI loops for iterative development. Claude works on the same task repeatedly, seeing its previous work, until completion.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Security reminder hook that warns about potential security issues when editing files, including command injection, XSS, and unsafe code patterns

plugins.name: algorithmic-art
plugins.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration

plugins.name: brand-guidelines
plugins.description: Applies TePS'EG official brand colors and typography to artifacts with visual formatting and style guidelines

plugins.name: canvas-design
plugins.description: Create beautiful visual art in PNG and PDF documents using design philosophy for posters, art, and static designs

plugins.name: doc-coauthoring
plugins.description: Guide users through structured workflow for co-authoring documentation, proposals, technical specs, and decision docs

plugins.name: docx
plugins.description: Comprehensive Word document creation, editing, and analysis with tracked changes, comments, and formatting preservation

plugins.name: internal-comms
plugins.description: Resources to write internal communications using preferred company formats

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text, creating PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms

plugins.name: pptx
plugins.description: Presentation creation, editing, and analysis for PowerPoint files with layouts and content modification

plugins.name: slack-gif-creator
plugins.description: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack with validation tools and animation concepts

plugins.name: theme-factory
plugins.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with themes - slides, docs, reports, HTML landing pages with 10 pre-set themes

plugins.name: webapp-testing
plugins.description: Toolkit for testing local web applications using Playwright with screenshots and browser interaction

plugins.name: web-artifacts-builder
plugins.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate HTML artifacts using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui

plugins.name: xlsx
plugins.description: Comprehensive spreadsheet creation, editing, and analysis with formulas, formatting, and visualization

plugins.name: gitlab-toolkit
plugins.description: Intelligent GitLab workflow automation with 46 commands and 8 agents. Features auto-detection hook, group management, project transfer/archive, CI/CD templates, and access audit.

plugins.name: project-context
plugins.description: Manage project context with CLAUDE.md templates. Track project state, phase, and knowledge across sessions with auto-detect for tech stacks.

plugins.name: dependency-check
plugins.description: Analyze project dependencies, check for vulnerabilities, and recommend updates. Supports npm, pip, cargo, go, bundler, and more.

plugins.name: debug-helper
plugins.description: Debug assistance with error analysis, log parsing, and debugging strategies for JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, and Rust.

plugins.name: refactoring
plugins.description: Code refactoring analysis with patterns, SOLID principles, code smells detection, and safe transformation strategies.

plugins.name: db-architect
plugins.description: DBA 역할의 데이터베이스 전문가 플러그인. 스키마 분석, 쿼리 최적화 제안, 마이그레이션 생성, N+1 쿼리 탐지, 인덱스 권장 기능 제공.

plugins.name: perf-analyzer
plugins.description: 성능 엔지니어 역할의 플러그인. CPU/메모리 프로파일링, 벤치마크 작성/실행, 코드 병목 패턴 탐지 기능 제공.

plugins.name: api-designer
plugins.description: API 아키텍트 역할의 플러그인. OpenAPI/Swagger 스펙 생성, RESTful 엔드포인트 설계, API 문서 자동화, Mock 서버 생성 기능 제공.

plugins.name: mobile-dev
plugins.description: 모바일 전문가 역할의 플러그인. iOS/Android 빌드 자동화, App Store/Play Store 메타데이터 관리, 앱 서명 설정, 베타 배포 기능 제공.

plugins.name: mcp-builder
plugins.description: MCP 서버 개발 가이드. Python (FastMCP) 또는 Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK)로 고품질 MCP 서버를 구축하는 방법 제공. 설계, 구현, 평가 도구 포함.

plugins.name: agent-sdk-dev
